data.title: Bitcoin vs Nvidia: $10,000 Invested 5 Years Ago, Which Is Worth More Now?
data.description: Five years ago, you had $10,000 to invest and two hot options: a volatile cryptocurrency riding a wave of hype, or a chipmaker few people outside gaming circles took seriously. The gap between where those two bets land today will surprise you.
